description:
List purchasable add-on packages

Returns the add-on packages the account may buy on top of its plan, for example extra voice minutes or extra chat conversations. Only packages that are both active and visible are listed, and, as with plans, a reseller customer sees that reseller's packages while a direct customer sees the platform's own. The order is the catalogue sort order chosen by whoever maintains the packages, not price or name. The response has a `data` array and no pagination block.
name: list_addons
title: List purchasable add-on packages
